::: {.page-lede}
I contribute to the quantitative methods and interdisciplinary research communities through **editorial service, peer review, professional leadership, and conference service**. These activities complement my research and teaching by keeping me engaged with emerging methodological work and the standards used to evaluate it.
:::

## Service Philosophy

I view professional service as part of the infrastructure of quantitative research. Reviewing, editorial work, and professional leadership help sustain rigorous methodological standards while also creating opportunities to support researchers and students working across substantive fields.
